source.prompt: A sheet of 128 separate grime streak masks in a grid of 16 columns by 8 rows, square, 2048x2048, each cell twice as tall as it is wide, on a solid flat pure white background. Front-on, flat, even, shadowless lighting; no text, no border, no grid lines. Each cell holds one vertical stain as on a wall below a window sill or a cornice: it starts at the top edge of its cell as a soft band and runs down, fading out before the bottom edge, nothing crossing into the next cell. Vary them: soot, damp, rust run-off, narrow drips, wide washes, single, forked and several parallel runs, some short, some long. Greyscale only, from pale grey to near-black where the stain is strongest, no colour at all.
